### Key Considerations for Complex Property & BFAs

- **Binding Financial Agreements (BFAs):** Under the *Family Law Act 1975* , BFAs require strict independent legal advice for both parties to be legally binding. Ensure whichever firm you choose has specific, proven depth in drafting or reviewing ironclad BFAs to avoid future set-aside applications.
- **Complex Assets:** If your pool involves business entities, discretionary trusts, self-managed super funds (SMSFs), or properties across Carindale/Wynnum, look for firms that routinely work with forensic accountants and valuation experts.[[1]](https://www.phillipsfamilylaw.com.au/how-we-can-help/property-settlements/)
- **Time Limits:** Remember that married couples have **12 months** post-divorce and de facto couples have **2 years** post-separation to file property settlement proceedings in court.[[1]](https://connorhunter.com/family-law-and-divorce/property-settlement-during-divorce-in-brisbane/)

If you can share:

- Whether you are **married or in a de facto relationship** 
- The **nature of the complex assets** (e.g., family businesses, trusts, multiple properties)
- Whether you are looking for a **local Bayside office** or willing to use a **CBD specialist firm** 

I can help narrow down the best fit or what questions to ask during an initial consultation.
